scenarios.name: Global Trade War Escalation
scenarios.description: Intensified trade disputes with China and the EU lead to renewed tariffs, disrupting supply chains and reducing exports.

impacts.explanation: New tariffs increase import costs and reduce export competitiveness.
Manufacturing output declines due to input shortages and demand contraction.
Trade friction reduces economic activity in export-driven sectors.

scenarios.reasoning: Base historical trade war patterns suggest moderate probability (outer view), while granular analysis of current tariff risks raises concern.
tetlockCommandments: Break seemingly intractable problems into tractable sub-problems

scenarios.name: Monetary Policy Stability
scenarios.description: Fed maintains current rates amid stable inflation, preserving investor confidence.

impacts.explanation: Persistent but controlled price pressures with no rate hikes.

scenarios.reasoning: Tetlock's cognitive debiasing requires monitoring base rates of inflation trends rather than overreacting to short-term fluctuations.

scenarios.name: Energy Supply Shock
scenarios.description: Middle East conflicts disrupt oil shipments, causing energy price volatility.

impacts.explanation: Higher energy costs spill over into broader price increases.
Market pricing in inflation risk raises bond yields.

scenarios.reasoning: Past energy crises (outer view) inform scenario weighting, while current geopolitical tensions (metric realities) adjust probabilities.
tetlockCommandments: Strike the right balance between inside and outside views

scenarios.name: Tech-Driven Productivity Surge
scenarios.description: AI and automation adoption accelerates in key industries, boosting output.

impacts.explanation: Labor productivity gains offset wage inflation pressures.
Growth from efficiency improvements in manufacturing and services.

scenarios.reasoning: Granular analysis of tech adoption rates (past adoption curves) supports moderate probability.

methodology: Probabilistic scenario modeling with Tetlock's pillars: weighted scenarios based on historical base rates (outside view), granular component analysis, and continuous probability updating.
geopoliticalSummary: Ongoing tensions in Eastern Europe and potential Middle East conflicts pose energy and trade risks.
geoeconomicSummary: Global supply chain reconfigurations and shifting trade patterns between major economies remain volatile.
currentEventsSummary: Technological innovation adoption and fiscal policy adjustments will shape near-term economic momentum.
